emotional_tone: Innovación tecnológica, seguridad, confianza, simplicidad, profesionalismo, elegancia sin ser fría

core_principles: Full dark mode: utilizing deep navy and obsidian to convey luxury and security.
Minimalist & Modern: Generous spacing (2-3x default), asymmetrical layouts.
Micro-interactions: Subtle glow accents, smooth staggered entrance animations, hover states revealing product benefits.
Professional but warm: Avoid sterile 'fintech' coldness by using subtle noise/grain textures and elegant typography.
anti_patterns: NO generic Inter or Roboto fonts.
NO fully symmetric boring center-aligned layouts.

headings.scale: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl for Hero (H1), text-3xl to 4xl for H2

spacing_and_layout.padding_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for large sections. Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use asymmetrical bento grids for 'Sobre Nosotros' and 'Cómo Funciona'. (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Prioritize optical alignment. Left-align dense text blocks and product information. Avoid default center alignment.

cards.style: Glassmorphism or solid dark. bg-[#111827]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#374151]/40 rounded-2xl.
cards.hover: Hover lifts the card slightly (-translate-y-1), increases border opacity, and adds a subtle shadow shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(11,27,58,0.3)].

buttons.primary: bg-white text-[#0A0A0A] font-semibold hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0B1B3A] text-white font-medium hover:bg-[#0B1B3A]/80 border border-[#374151] px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.floating_contact: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-white text-black p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-transform z-50 flex items-center justify-center

product_gallery.card_behavior: On hover, the main product image dims or scales up slightly, revealing the description, colors, and benefits text overlaid or sliding up. Includes a prominent 'Comprar' button.

navigation.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 border-b border-[#374151]/30

motion_and_interaction.entrance: Staggered fade-up animations (Framer Motion) for grid items and gallery products.
motion_and_interaction.microinteractions: Buttons scale down slightly on active/click. Subtly glowing borders on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on deep navy/obsidian backgrounds passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, form inputs, and key navigation links MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided: #0B1B3A (Azul Profundo), #1C1C1E (Negro Carbón), #374151 (Gris Acero), #111827 (Azul Nocturno), #0A0A0A (Negro Obsidiana), #FFFFFF (Blanco). Do NOT use generic tailwind colors that break this scheme.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Use 'General Sans' or 'Geist'. Install via fontsource if necessary.
Ensure the hero background has a dark overlay to maintain text readability.
Implement the product cards with a hover effect where the benefits and 'Comprar' button slide up or fade in.
Add a floating contact button fixed at the bottom right corner on all pages.
All text content must be in Spanish as requested.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) as per testing guidelines.
